remove.html.src:
<!doctype html>
<button id="bell">Ring</button>
<button id="unplug">Unplug</button>
<script>
  const bell = document.querySelector("#bell");
  function ring() {
    console.log("Ding dong!");
  }
  bell.addEventListener("click", ring);
  bell.addEventListener("click", () => console.log("Bravo!"));

  document.querySelector("#unplug").addEventListener("click", () => {
    bell.removeEventListener("click", ring);
    bell.removeEventListener("click", () => console.log("Bravo!"));
    console.log("Tried to unplug both.");
  });
</script>
